'''Flying Decks''' was the nickname given to the ancient [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ships used by the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] to move their [[Chaos trooper|shocktroops]] from [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to planet. The wings and main engines were at the front of the T-shaped ship.
